query: SELECT 'molecule', COUNT(*) FROM molecule UNION ALL SELECT 'atom', COUNT(*) FROM atom UNION ALL SELECT 'bond', COUNT(*) FROM bond UNION ALL SELECT 'connected', COUNT(*) FROM connected
validation_method: read-only row counts on all four tables

query: SELECT label, COUNT(*) FROM molecule GROUP BY label
result: exactly two distinct values: '+' 152 and '-' 191; total 343

query: SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS m FROM atom GROUP BY element ORDER BY c DESC
validation_method: value-domain enumeration with counts and molecule coverage

query: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS m FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY c DESC
result: '-' 10528 bonds/442 molecules; '=' 1844/370; '#' 6/4; plus one group of 1 row whose bond_type is NULL

query: SELECT 'atom.element null', COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element IS NULL UNION ALL ... (NULL audit) ; SELECT bond_id, molecule_id, quote(bond_type) FROM bond WHERE bond_type IS NULL OR bond_type NOT IN ('-','=','#')
result: No NULLs in atom.element, atom.molecule_id, bond.molecule_id, molecule.label, or connected.bond_id. Exactly one anomalous bond row: bond_id TR345_7_10, molecule TR345, bond_type NULL.
validation_method: explicit NULL audit across all nullable columns plus anomaly filter on the bond-type domain

result: Four tables: molecule(molecule_id PK, label); atom(atom_id PK, molecule_id FK->molecule, element); bond(bond_id PK, molecule_id FK->molecule, bond_type); connected(atom_id, atom_id2 composite PK, bond_id FK->bond) with FKs from atom_id and atom_id2 to atom. Element, bond type and label are all inline value columns; no element, bond-type or label dimension table exists.
validation_method: schema inspection of the SQLite DDL

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom_id LIKE molecule_id || '\_%' ESCAPE '\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM atom; (same for bond)
result: atom: 12333 of 12333 identifiers are prefixed with their molecule_id followed by '_'. bond: 12379 of 12379 likewise. bond_id examples: TR000_1_2, TR001_10_11.

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM atom), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond); ... LEFT JOIN molecule ... WHERE m.molecule_id IS NULL
result: molecule rows 343; distinct atom.molecule_id 444; distinct bond.molecule_id 444. The 101 orphan identifiers are the same set in both tables (full overlap), covering 3222 atom rows and 3223 bond rows. Examples: TR003, TR005, TR013, TR016, TR018, TR026, TR027, TR042.
validation_method: referential integrity check by anti-join on the declared foreign key

query: SELECT n, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT bond_id, COUNT(*) n FROM connected GROUP BY bond_id) GROUP BY n ORDER BY n; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = atom_id2
result: Every bond_id occurs exactly twice (12379 bonds -> 24758 adjacency rows, all groups of size 2). Zero self-pairs where atom_id = atom_id2.
validation_method: cardinality grouping per bond plus self-loop check

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id=c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id=c.atom_id WHERE a.atom_id IS NULL; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id=c.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id <> (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id=c.atom_id)
result: 0 orphan bond references, 0 orphan atom references, and 0 rows where the bond's molecule differs from the atom's molecule. All connectivity entries are internally consistent.
validation_method: anti-join referential checks across connected, bond and atom

query: SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id=a.atom_id) GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY 2 DESC
result: 49 atoms have no adjacency entry: na 35, h 7, cl 5, zn 1, k 1. Example molecules: TR006, TR011, TR101, TR158, TR172. Separately, 0 molecules lack atoms and 0 molecules lack bonds.
validation_method: anti-join on connected per atom, grouped by element

query: SELECT m.label, COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) mols, COUNT(a.atom_id) atoms, ROUND(AVG(x.n),2) avg_atoms FROM molecule m JOIN (...) ; plus hydrogen and heavy-atom counts per label; plus bond-type counts per label
result: Label '+': 152 molecules, 3692 atoms, average 36.20 atoms, 1569 hydrogen atoms, 2123 heavy atoms, 3078 single bonds, 634 double bonds, 3 triple bonds. Label '-': 191 molecules, 5419 atoms, average 38.43 atoms, 2465 hydrogen atoms, 2954 heavy atoms, 4665 single bonds, 774 double bonds, 2 triple bonds.

query: SELECT MIN(c), MAX(c), AVG(c) FROM (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) c FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id); (same over bond) ; top molecules by atom count
result: Per-molecule atoms: min 4, max 174, mean 27.78. Per-molecule bonds: min 2, max 175, mean 27.88. Largest molecules by atom count: TR338 174, TR496 109, TR060 103, TR059 102, TR397 88.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, element, COUNT(*) c FROM atom GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING c>1); (same for bond); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule mo WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id=mo.molecule_id)
result: No duplicate atom or bond rows. Every one of the 343 labelled molecules has at least one atom and at least one bond; every atom and bond row has a non-NULL molecule reference.

query: SELECT m.label, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element='h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) h_cnt, COUNT(*) tot FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id=m.molecule_id GROUP BY m.label; SELECT m.label, COUNT(*) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id=m.molecule_id WHERE a.element<>'h' GROUP BY m.label
result: Hydrogen atoms: 1569 for '+', 2465 for '-'. Heavy (non-hydrogen) atoms: 2123 for '+', 2954 for '-'. Overall hydrogen atoms 5518 of 12333 atoms.
